title.value: AN ACT relating to toxic chemicals
title.provenance: "AN ACT relating to toxic chemicals; prohibiting, with certain exceptions, the discharge, use or release of certain Class B firefighting foams; ..."

location.provenance: "THE PEOPLE OF THE STATE OF NEVADA, REPRESENTED IN SENATE AND ASSEMBLY, DO ENACT AS FOLLOWS:"

pfas_definition.provenance: "'Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals that contain at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom."

type.provenance: "Section 12... shall not discharge, use or release, ... any Class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances"

who.provenance: "a person, political subdivision, local government or state or local agency shall not discharge, use or release..." (Section 12)

value: Class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
products.provenance: "any Class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances" (Section 12)

value: Testing the foam with required containment, treatment and disposal measures
exceptions.provenance: "(a) Testing the Class B firefighting foam ... unless the person testing the foam has ensured that any measures necessary for the proper containment, treatment and disposal of the foam are available..." (Section 12)(a); "(b) Firefighting training." (Section 12)(b)

type.provenance: "Section 13... must report the discharge, use or release to the Division not later than 24 hours after the discharge, use or release."

who.provenance: "any person, political subdivision, local government or state or local agency who discharges, uses or releases... must report..." (Section 13)

action.provenance: "must report the discharge, use or release..." (Section 13)

value: Class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
products.provenance: "Class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances" (Section 13)
